strand_b.title: Co-creating climate-resilient cities: a multi-method participatory approach for future scenario building and prioritization
strand_b.authors: Havva Ebrahimipour, Monika Mačiulienė, Anna Maria Kotrikla, Franz-Ferdinand Rothe, Gintarė Gulevičiūtė, Aelita Skaržauskienė, Kristina Kovaitė, Amalia Polydoropoulou, et al.
strand_b.summary: Co-creating climate-resilient cities: a multi-method participatory approach for future scenario building and prioritization. Abstract While global frameworks such as the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) call for participatory planning processes that embed local priorities into future-oriented climate action, mainstream urban planning and governance approaches often remain rigid and disconnected from local concerns, leading to a critical vision-to-decision gap. This study introduces and tests a multi-method participatory foresight framework for developing locally grounded climate-resilient urban futures, bridging the gap between community-led visioning and formal administrative prioritization.
